kept.spine: The City Council at Rundgate holds a modest edge in its own favour, and few of its requests are refused.
Rundgate credits the City Council with its good years whether or not the council earned them, and prosperity is the whole of the case made in its favour.
What is settled at Rundgate is the hall and only the hall, and the town's steadiness is a statement about who answers and not about what the answers turn out to be.
A criminal operation with real local weight sits inside Rundgate, whether counted in ground held or in coin taken, and no sharper account of it exists.
The City Council watches Rundgate's own temper more closely than it watches any rival, since it is unrest and not a rival that unseats a council.

kept.spine: A stranger who calls the City Council at Rundgate by any other name is corrected immediately, and the correction is polite.
The City Council outweighs every rival at Rundgate who wants its place, and the hold is real without being comfortable.

kept.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public backing hardens the hold
kept.spine: Public backing at Rundgate is hardening the City Council's grip, so what would be a real contest elsewhere is no more than an inconvenience here. That public backing counts for more in the council's favour than its standing alone would earn.
